claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc robustness and closest-simple-baseline analysis on the active shared-3DSSG candidate pool. It does not select a new source-score mapping, claim score-scale invariance, or treat evaluation-verifier baselines as deployable methods.
classification: post-hoc robustness and closest-simple-baseline analysis; no method selection

hard_drop.definition: Remove every primary-verifier-violated candidate, retain source order among the remaining candidates, and report the resulting selected count.

hard_tail.definition: Within each re-ranked family, retain source order among non-violated rows and then among violated rows; preserve source family slots and support/contact order.

positive_density.definition: Diagonal robust density around train-positive predicate medians, scaled by IQR, transformation-averaged and multiplied by the source score under the active family-slot route.
